changelog: Added in-world 3D Debug Visualizer for all macro-regions, polygon walls, Y-axis boundaries, buffer corridors, and live blend percentage HUD.
Added Freecam Polygon Creator & Editor: fly across the map to create, move, resize (scroll wheel), reshape, or delete macro-regions dynamically.
Made the Climate & Weather UI fully reactive to newly created, edited, or deleted regions, with a critical warning for deleting base regions and a full Reset to Defaults button.
